description: Read a web page or PDF with AgentReader (agentreader.xyz) and return only its main content as clean Markdown (default) or JSON. Prefer this over a plain fetch when the page is JavaScript-rendered, behind a cookie/consent wall, a PDF, or large (raw HTML can be 20x the tokens). If the site blocks bots or is paywalled you get a clear error, are not charged, and should move on instead of retrying URL variants. Renders JavaScript with headless Chromium when needed and keeps code blocks verbatim. JSON adds title, author, date, links and tables. News homepages return headline lists, RSS/Atom feeds return items, mode=full returns the whole page. StackOverflow, npm and PyPI are read via their official APIs. Results with very little text carry meta.warning; if a result looks wrong, call report_issue. Pricing: 5 free reads/day without an API key; then credits on a key, which comes from a card pack your user buys at https://agentreader.xyz/buy ($3 for 2,000 reads or $10 for 7,000 reads + VAT where applicable) or from a crypto bundle (POST https://agentreader.xyz/v1/credits/buy?bundle=500, x402). Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <key> (apps that can't set headers: connect to https://agentreader.xyz/mcp?api_key=<key>). Or pay $0.005/read via x402 in the tool call.

extract.description: Returns named fields (title, author, date, price, currency, image, brand, sku, rating, availability, summary…) from JSON-LD, OpenGraph, microdata and meta tags. No LLM. Missing fields are null. In JSON as `fields`, in Markdown as front matter. Default: (none).

format.description: markdown returns the content as Markdown only. json wraps the same Markdown with title, author, date, word count, links, tables and metadata (meta.warning flags results that may be incomplete); there is no separate plain-text copy. Default: markdown.

mode.description: article: main content only. links: list of headlines with links. full: the whole page, including non-article parts. auto picks article or links based on the page. RSS/Atom feeds always return their items. Default: auto.

render.description: Whether to load the page in headless Chromium. auto does so only when plain fetching returns too little. Default: auto.

url.description: The page, PDF or RSS/Atom feed to read. Also accepted as u or link, without https://, or path style /v1/read/https://….

name: read_url
title: Read URL / web page / PDF to Markdown
